video.title: AI欧腐《冰上燃火/Bottom to Top,Ice on Fire》
video.desc:
单板滑雪 
A fallen snowboarding prodigy, Kieran, now a forbearing physio, faces relentless bullying from an arrogant reigning champion Axel — unaware his nemesis has secretly obsessed over him for years. To force the ex-champ back to his peak, Axel orchestrates a high-stakes healing trap while hiding a fatal secret. Together, they conquer life and death, reclaim the summit, and achieve ultimate mutual redemption.
Kieran 曾是单板滑雪的天才少年，如今跌落神坛，成了一名隐忍的理疗师。狂妄的现任冠军 Axel 对他百般刁难，毫不留情——而 Kieran 并不知道，这个死对头其实已经暗暗痴迷他多年。
为了逼这位前冠军重返巅峰，Axel 精心设下一场高风险的"治疗陷阱"，同时隐瞒着一个致命的秘密。两人携手闯过生死、重登顶峰，最终达成彼此的救赎。
